verdict.rationale: Stripe's payouts docs confirm automated payouts from available balance and dashboard tracking of payout dates (stripe-docs-34, stripe-docs-52), and refunds/disputes/fees are documented separately (stripe-docs-17, stripe-docs-33, stripe-docs-40, stripe-docs-41), implying the underlying data exists for reconciliation. However, there is no direct evidence of configurable payout schedule controls (e.g., daily/weekly/manual/custom) or of a payout reconciliation report/API that itemizes which specific charges, fees, and refunds compose each payout. missing for 10: explicit payout schedule configuration options, itemized payout reconciliation report/balance transaction breakdown per payout, and any hands-on/community confirmation of this workflow.
